focusedAudit.reason: A Beta release; no exact-tree release audit was run for this Beta; explicit deferral, not certification.

items.text: Diagnostics: when a block's editor does not have the caret one frame after Tine asked it to edit (for example after Enter), the diagnostic report now records a content-free `editor.focus-missed` event (whether the window had focus, whether an edit guard held the request, whether the editor was mounted, and the focused element's kind; no note text, titles or paths), at most once every five minutes, so a report can tell the possible causes apart (GH #939).

regressionEvidence.reason: Catalog coverage: REG-939-EDITOR-FOCUS-MISSED-DIAGNOSTIC. Fail-before: proven. Gated on develop and release/0.9 (Linux native journeys).

items.text: Copying a collapsed block, or a block shown as a sheet (table, board or grid), with Ctrl/Cmd+C on a block selection or Copy blocks in the block menu puts the children it hides on the clipboard, nested folds included; before, with the default "Copy a parent block's sub-blocks" off, the copied text silently left them out. An expanded parent selected alone still copies alone; with the setting on, copies remain whole subtrees as in Logseq (GH #943).

regressionEvidence.reason: Catalog coverage: UI-GH943-COLLAPSED-COPY. Fail-before: proven. Gated on develop and release/0.9 (Linux native journeys).

items.text: Org pages: Linked References now mark a link inside emphasis (`*[[page]]*`) or inside a `#[[…]]` tag where it stands, also inside quote and other `#+BEGIN_…` blocks, instead of missing it or marking the start of the block (internal: REG-LSDOC-0511-ORG-LINK-SPANS).

items.text: An empty task (a bare `TODO` or `DONE` with no text) stays a task when Tine gives it a block id, folds it or schedules it, in Org and Markdown pages; before, the saved file was read back as the plain word. A bare task Logseq saved with an id drawer now opens as a task too (internal: REG-BARE-TASK-HIDDEN-ROWS).
